name: governance-control-plane
description: A local control plane for driving an effort through the nine-stage SDLC loop, with gates that record decisions instead of mutating state.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test "dist/test/*.test.js" "test/*.test.mjs" && npm run test:web && npm run test:i18n && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:demo
scripts.serve: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js serve
scripts.scan: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js scan
scripts.advance: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js advance
